coverage_gaps: No citation-graph or DOI-metadata route is available, so backward and forward citation expansion and independent publication-link validation are limited.
No Embase or other subject index beyond PubMed is available, creating possible coverage loss for non-MEDLINE journals and conference records.
No non-US regulator route is available, so EMA and other jurisdictional actions cannot be systematically compared with FDA actions.
No preprint route is available; recent unreviewed analyses through the cutoff may be missed.
No individual-patient-data, sponsor clinical-study-report, or FDA review-package route is supplied, limiting independent verification of adjudication, subgroup, and time-to-event analyses.
The 16-query cap leaves no separate PubMed temporal-update event after preserving route-specific anchors and distinct challenge searches for all four high-impact outcome families.
exclusion_criteria: Preclinical, animal, in vitro, mechanism-only, or pharmacokinetic studies lacking decision-relevant human safety outcomes.
Diseases other than rheumatoid arthritis unless the record directly informed an FDA class-wide action or explicitly separates an interpretable rheumatoid arthritis subgroup.
Efficacy-only publications with no cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, mortality, regulatory, or evidence-integrity relevance.
Narrative commentary, news coverage, promotional material, or secondary summaries when the underlying trial, registry, publication, or FDA primary document is available.
Duplicate database records that add no distinct version, correction, registry history, regulatory date, or query-to-record provenance.
Records first made available after 2024-12-31, while preserving later-linked metadata only as out-of-window audit information.
Safety reports without an identifiable tofacitinib exposure group or without enough information to determine population, comparator, outcome, and timing.
Unverified claims of correction or retraction lacking confirmation in PubMed publication types, linked notices, or the primary record metadata.
inclusion_criteria: Records available on or before 2024-12-31, with online-first, issue, registry-update, and regulatory-effective dates recorded separately.

The ORAL Surveillance registry record, its change history and posted results, the primary peer-reviewed publication, directly linked secondary analyses, and FDA actions or labels tied to the postauthorization requirement.
Marketed tofacitinib exposure in adults with rheumatoid arthritis, with priority to the trial-enriched population aged 50 years or older with at least one cardiovascular risk factor.
Evidence reporting cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, mortality, dose effects, subgroup effects, risk modifiers, or benefit-risk interpretation.
Qualifying or conflicting peer-reviewed randomized, observational, registry, cohort, or meta-analytic evidence with an explicit tofacitinib group and interpretable comparator or reference population.
Corrections, errata, retractions, expressions of concern, protocol changes, registry amendments, and FDA communications or labeling changes that alter evidence interpretation.
English-language records or records with sufficient English metadata and outcome information for reliable screening.
Each canonical record must retain every query-to-record link and be deduplicated by PMID, DOI, NCT identifier, FDA document identity, title, and publication date without discarding distinct versions.

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal primary publication and verify the trial name, registry identifier, sponsor identifier, intervention, comparator, and primary safety outcomes.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR A3921133[Title/Abstract]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "Tofacitinib"[Supplementary Concept]) AND ("Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk"[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Recover the authoritative ORAL Surveillance registry record and its identifiers, design, arms, outcome definitions, dates, results, and linked publications.
Recover FDA actions explicitly tied to the required postmarketing safety trial.
queries.query: tofacitinib ORAL Surveillance NCT02092467 FDA Drug Safety Communication

queries.purpose: Discover peer-reviewed RA safety evidence across all decision-critical outcome families through the cutoff.
queries.query: (("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR CP-690550[Title/Abstract]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR embol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortalit*[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Confirm cardiovascular estimates, endpoint definitions, dose findings, subgroup findings, and limitations from trial-linked publications.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND ("major adverse cardiovascular event*"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR myocardial infarction[Title/Abstract] OR stroke[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular death[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Confirm malignancy estimates, exclusions, cancer types, latency analyses, dose findings, and risk modifiers.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR lymphoma[Title/Abstract] OR "lung cancer"[Title/Abstract] OR "nonmelanoma skin cancer"[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Confirm venous and arterial thrombosis findings, pulmonary embolism signals, dose dependence, and protocol changes.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR "venous thromboembolism"[Title/Abstract] OR VTE[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR "deep vein thrombosis"[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Confirm all-cause, cardiovascular, thrombotic, malignancy-related, and other fatal-event findings.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (mortalit*[Title/Abstract] OR death*[Title/Abstract] OR fatal*[Title/Abstract] OR "all-cause mortality"[Title/Abstract] OR "cardiovascular mortality"[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Cross-check registered primary and secondary outcomes, statistical plan elements, enrollment, disposition, posted results, update history, and publication links against the primary paper.
queries.query: AREA[StudyId]NCT02092467 AND (MACE OR malignancy OR pulmonary embolism OR thrombosis OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Recover the chronology and exact scope of FDA alerts, interim actions, final conclusions, boxed-warning changes, indication restrictions, and effective labeling dates.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz rheumatoid arthritis safety trial blood clots death cancer serious heart-related events boxed warning 2019 2021 label

queries.purpose: Seek independent cardiovascular evidence that supports, attenuates, conflicts with, or limits transportability of ORAL Surveillance.
queries.query: (("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract]) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR "real-world"[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR meta-analysis[Title/Abstract] OR bias[Title/Abstract] OR generalizab*[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Seek independent malignancy evidence, including null findings, different comparators, follow-up limitations, and population-risk differences.
queries.query: (("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND (malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract]) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR "real-world"[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR meta-analysis[Title/Abstract] OR bias[Title/Abstract] OR generalizab*[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Seek qualifying or conflicting thrombosis evidence, dose effects, risk-factor stratification, and alternative comparator findings.
queries.query: (("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND (thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR "venous thromboembolism"[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract]) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR "real-world"[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR meta-analysis[Title/Abstract] OR dose[Title/Abstract] OR risk factor*[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Seek independent mortality evidence and assess precision, causal attribution, competing risks, and confounding.
queries.query: (("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND (mortalit*[Title/Abstract] OR death*[Title/Abstract]) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR "real-world"[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR meta-analysis[Title/Abstract] OR confound*[Title/Abstract] OR competing risk*[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Identify corrections, errata, retractions, or expressions of concern affecting the pivotal publication or directly relied-upon safety evidence.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]) AND (correction[Title] OR erratum[Title] OR retraction[Title] OR "expression of concern"[Title] OR "corrected and republished"[Publication Type] OR Retraction of Publication[Publication Type]))

queries.purpose: Check for later FDA communications, label revisions, enforcement-relevant updates, or changes in regulatory interpretation through the as-of date.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz safety communication labeling update rheumatoid arthritis after:2021-12-01 before:2025-01-01 cardiovascular malignancy thrombosis mortality

question_frame: Safety PECO: adults with rheumatoid arthritis aged 50 years or older and at least one cardiovascular risk factor; marketed tofacitinib exposure at evaluated doses; active TNF-inhibitor comparator and relevant qualifying RA evidence; outcomes of major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy excluding nonmelanoma skin cancer, venous or arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and all-cause or cardiovascular mortality through 2024-12-31. Link ORAL Surveillance to its registry record, primary publication, FDA communications and labeling actions, and assess conflicting evidence plus correction or retraction status.
stop_rules: Complete all 16 planned query events across pubmed, clinicaltrials_gov, and fda_regulatory, recording exact query, execution timestamp, requested cutoff, result count, and provider version when available.

Do not stop until the pivotal publication, NCT02092467 registry record, and FDA action chronology are recovered and their trial identifiers, population, arms, doses, endpoints, dates, and publication links are reconciled.

Do not stop until each of cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality has at least one trial-linked confirmation search and one distinct challenge search for qualifying, null, conflicting, or limiting evidence.
Do not stop until correction, erratum, retraction, and expression-of-concern status has been checked for every decision-critical publication and any notice has been linked to its affected record.

Resolve conflicting duplicate metadata, outcome definitions, event counts, dates, or identifiers by checking the primary registry, publication, and FDA document; unresolved conflicts remain explicit coverage gaps and block a definitive claim.
Apply the 2024-12-31 cutoff after retrieval when indexing syntax is ambiguous and preserve online-first, issue, registry-update, and FDA effective dates separately.
Stop expansion when the fixed 16-event budget is exhausted after all anchor and challenge branches are completed; report budget exhaustion and omit any unsupported completeness claim.

Stop synthesis only when every included claim is traceable to a canonical record, every canonical record retains its query provenance, and further retrieval within the available routes is unlikely to change the assessment.
